title: Fixed: limit on number of packages + add `rworkflows`
description:
* Fix `cran_downloads` and prevent it from failing with many packages:
  https://github.com/r-hub/cranlogs/issues/56
* Speed up `cran_downloads` with parallelisation.
* Add new unit test for `cran_downloads` with lots of packages.
* Remove `dontrun{}` from `cran_downloads` and `cran_top_downloads` examples.
  Unclear why this was here?
* New support function: `message_parallel`, `split_batches`
* Replace travis (failing)  and pkgdown with `rworkflows`.
* Update Authors in *DESCRIPTION* to reflect contribution, make fields explicit.
* Add *node_modules$* to *.Rbuildignore*.

All you need to do on your end @gaborcsardi is add GH token as a GH secret named "PAT_GITHUB" to the `cranlogs` repo.

Best, 
Brian

title: added use_cranlogs_badge
description: Added `use_cranlogs_badge`.  I harvested `project_name` from `usethis` (couldn't find an exposed function), which adds a heavy load of deps: `desc`, `fs`, `rprojroot`, and `usethis`.  Added to suggests so that they are not hard deps.  So take it or leave it - may not be enough to warrant the dependencies.

title: Return data as a tibble
description:
This is a bit of a stylistic preference but my understanding is that tibbles are now preferred to data.frames.

This PR:
* Adds tibble as a dependency
* Uses tibble::tibble for returned data
* Renames {to_df*} functions to {to_tibble*}
* Supplementary updates to documentation from runing `devtools::document()`

No dramas if you prefer data frames though

description: Updated line for argument "when" to change from last_day, last_week or last_month to last-day, last-week or last-month. Recreated documentation so change is reflected there as well.

title: Fix arguments description for `when` parameter
description: `last_day` to `last-day` and so on. One fix at a time.

title: Set "to" be current date if it's missing
description:
Added a IF check to see if the "to" argument is missing (while "from" is given). If it's missing, then "to" will be set to the current date by default.

I guess this is a quite common demand as we always want to know the situation "until now". This also makes this function more "robust".
